action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py now 1817 lines — split legal/AML/testament into a routes/legal.py module.
OPTIONAL: _aml_ledger_append does two find_one calls (last entry_hash + last seq) — combine into one find_one that returns both fields for a single Mongo roundtrip.

OPTIONAL: Under concurrent donations by the same user, _donations_today (read) + insert is not atomic — a burst could bypass the daily limit by 1-2 tx. Consider a Mongo transaction or a per-user counter with $inc + conditional check.
OPTIONAL: legal_testament stores document_text and doc_hash but never re-verifies the hash on GET — add a helper endpoint that recomputes and returns tamper status.
OPTIONAL: TOS_TEXT contains ver placeholder but no changelog; when TOS_VERSION bumps every existing user will be re-gated silently — consider a diff/changelog field so users see what changed.
critical_code_review_comments: resolve_jurisdiction correctly maps GB→UK, US/CA/AU/NZ/IE→common_law (US branch further pinned to jurisdiction 'US' inside DISCLAIMERS), else EU for EU codes, else OTHER — verified across all 4 branches.
AML thresholds AML_UNVERIFIED_DAILY=150, AML_VERIFIED_DAILY=5000, AML_MAX_TX_PER_DAY=10 are consistent between /legal/region response and enforcement in /solidarity/donate — no drift.
Ledger append is monotonic: seq derived from sort seq desc + 1, prev_hash from last entry — chain integrity verified across 4+ entries in test.
KYC attestation is a sha256 of did|full_name|birth_year|country|date — deterministic per day, changes if identity data changes. Good for periodic re-attestation.
Testament instructions correctly cite § 476 Občianskeho zákonníka SR for civil law holograph and Wills Act 1837 s.9 for E&W — legally accurate references.

TOS gate on frontend (index.tsx line 54) checks tos_accepted_version !== '2026-06.1' — hard-coded version string; should read from a shared constant OR from GET /api/legal/tos to stay in sync when TOS_VERSION bumps. Minor coupling risk.

AI compliance note is appended to translator, physio, advice, wellness-checkin(?) — verified translator still returns valid JSON-adjacent structure after append; wellness checkin already returns strict JSON so compliance note is inside system prompt but does not break output parsing.
